subtitle: Guided Progression — Build Journey & Reliable Release Delivery
changes: Added optional four-step Guided Progression to Talent Forge: goals, official talent-tree exploration, manual point allocation, and build review.
Enhanced build review with planned node and rank totals by Class, Specialization, and Hero trees, plus advisory source-link warnings.
Improved navigation from the guided experience into existing Talent Forge goals, Talent Atlas, and Path Navigator without changing official Blizzard node positions.
Saved builds still use the original Talent Forge save controls, preserving existing recovery, undo/redo, and manual allocation behavior.
Hardened Discord release delivery with a longer GitHub Pages publication check, safer webhook retry handling, and clearer logging for confirmed versus unconfirmed posts.
